notes: All attempts use fresh private browsers/profiles and at most six explicit public strategy ends. Actual random months are retained; no forced orders, RNG/world writes or hidden retries.
Candidate identities use direct zero-based native IDs and full packed names, independently derived from the actual allied resident queue; no name-to-ID inference.
Incoming order is uniquely matched against Order27/Object and the complete ten LE-U16 FIGHTERS tokens. It is not a directly published BattleDrv local; TimeCount0 is not a universal acceptance gate.
DelPerson shifts only through slot198, retains slot199 and leaves slots200..1999 unchanged; later city offsets change by city index. The entire recorded strategic world is compared.
The initial defensive PICK is the first actual wait observed by callback/16ms readonly polling before any battle action; it is not claimed to be a synchronous native PICK event.

Only current explicit finish with remaining residents is accepted here. Zero/exhausted/ten-choice initialization, upgrade/death branches, defense victory/defeat, post-battle settlement, other periods/cities, RNG continuity, real devices, performance and full HD remain pending.
